edges.description: README describes the React frontend setup and user-facing app flow.
README describes the FastAPI backend setup and runtime commands.
Docker README documents the compose-based deployment flow.
Docker Compose runs the backend service.
Docker Compose builds and serves the frontend application.
The container image runs the backend application process.
Environment variables configure backend API keys and runtime behavior.
Environment variables configure Firebase frontend integration.
The frontend API client calls backend FastAPI routes.
The frontend API client follows the backend API contract.
The frontend application layer is connected to the reusable UI primitives layer.
The Home screen is associated with reusable card UI primitives.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand BuyAI's shopping assistant purpose, main AI features, and setup flow.

tour.title: Frontend Entry and Screens
tour.description: Review the Vite React entry point and main screens to see how users navigate search, chat, saved items, and authentication.

tour.title: Frontend API Boundary
tour.description: Inspect the frontend API client to understand how UI actions call the backend search, chat, visual search, and auth endpoints.

tour.title: Backend API and AI Logic
tour.description: Trace the FastAPI application and AI services that power search, product recommendations, translation, and visual retrieval.

tour.title: Data, Auth, and Deployment
tour.description: Finish with persistence, Firebase authentication support, seeded product data, and Docker-based deployment files.
